purpose: PSD-aware visual proposal and relation review using composite, graph overlay, UI graph, and layer metadata.
rules: Use the composite image for visual evidence and graph_overlay.png for grounding ids and local relation evidence.
Return missing_region_proposals only when a visible UI element is absent from supplied candidates.
All bbox values are approximate proposals and must be treated as quarantine input by the program.
Do not delete existing PSD/local candidates.
Prefer relation_patches and component_group_patches over inventing new boxes when existing candidates explain the UI.
When a proposal overlaps an existing candidate, reference related_candidate_ids instead of creating a replacement.
For asset_sheet documents, describe repeated controls and sprite components without forcing a screen hierarchy.
Return JSON matching the strict structured output schema.
